avis.texte: I just turned 50 years old and tend to have dry to combo skin, depending on the time of year. I also tend to have pretty good sized pores, some very milk wrinkles starting and very uneven skin tone. I have tried several serums that grabbed some hype and was not happy. My 22 year old son was using the toner by this brand, tried it and liked it. I saw it on sale on Amazon and figured I would give it a go. First I love the Medicube toner, this serum and the Collagen Moisturizer. I was shocked. The toner just feels fresh and doesnt dry my skin out. I like to use it to start my day or even at night after stressful day before i put my nighttime stuff on. This serum I tend to save for morning. I just love the smoother look of my skin, the smaller my pores look and just more even tone. I double it for the day at work with the Moisturizer. I let it dry before putting any coverage on my face or sometimes I will just go to work without coverage. I noticed a difference and sometimes get people saying something about looking like "your face is just opened up". I have used it for a couple weeks now. A little goes a long way for sure. I barely put much of the serem or the moisturizer on and I am good to go. My skin looks more plump and just hydrated. Yea so far, it might be a long term favorite! It did make me want to try some of the other products from Medicube.

avis.titre: Rich, bouncy, and nourishing — great for mature skin that needs extra support
avis.texte: This Triple Collagen Serum was such a pleasant surprise. At 52 with post-menopause skin, I’m always looking for products that give me that “bouncy” look without feeling heavy, and this one does exactly that. The texture is silky and slightly creamy but absorbs beautifully, leaving my skin soft and cushiony instead of greasy. I love that this uses three different collagen types. Even though topical collagen doesn’t replace what we lose naturally, it absolutely helps with hydration, firmness, and that smoother look. After about a week of using it, I noticed my skin looked less dull and had more elasticity, especially around my cheeks and jawline. It also plays really well with my other serums — no pilling, no stickiness. This is one of those serums that feels comforting on the skin. On days when my skin feels a little dry or tight (thank you, menopause), this gives an instant plumping effect and makes my moisturizer work even better. If you want something nourishing that instantly improves texture and gives a healthy glow, this is a great addition — especially for mature skin. I’ll definitely keep this one in my rotation.

avis.titre: None sticky, smells amazing and absorbs really well. Very impressed!None sticky, smells amazing and absorbs really well.
avis.texte: I’ve been really impressed with this serum so far. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. It layers well under moisturiser and makeup, making it easy to use both morning and night. The combination of triple collagen, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid leaves my skin feeling hydrated, softer and looking brighter after each use. A little goes a long way, so the 55ml bottle should last a while. I’ve only been using it for a short time, so I can’t comment on any long-term firming or anti-ageing results yet, but my skin already feels smoother and well moisturised. Pros: * Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula. * Leaves skin feeling soft, hydrated and smooth. * Doesn’t feel greasy or sticky. * Works well under moisturiser and makeup. * A little goes a long way, making the bottle good value. Cons: * Long-term firming and anti-ageing benefits will take time to see. * Those with very sensitive skin may want to patch test first because it contains active ingredients. Overall, this is a lovely Korean skincare serum that’s easy to incorporate into a daily routine. I’d happily recommend it to anyone looking for a lightweight hydrating serum that gives skin a healthy-looking glow.
